---
title: "phibble"
subtitle: "A typed data frame for PHP"
---

Load, transform, and summarize typed data frames in PHP. Tables are
immutable, and `null` represents missing data. Names and semantics follow R's
tibble, readr, and dplyr.

This summary reads the Palmer penguins data,
[`penguins.csv`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phpstats/phibble/{{< var release >}}/docs/data/penguins.csv):

{{< include examples/_tour.md >}}

```bash
composer require phpstats/phibble
```

phibble requires PHP 8.3, 8.4, or 8.5, and the mbstring and PDO extensions.
[Installation](getting-started.qmd#installation) lists the optional
extensions.

## Backends

| Class | Runs in | Needs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Phibble\DataFrame` | PHP arrays | — |
| `Phibble\Sql\SqlTable` | SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL | PDO |
| `Phibble\Polars\PolarsTable` | Polars | the php_polars extension from [phpolars](https://github.com/phpstats/phpolars) |

A step that a backend cannot run, such as a PHP closure, runs in a
`DataFrame`. [Backends](backends.qmd) lists where results can differ.

## Other packages

These PHPstats packages read or return phibble tables:

- [phplyr](https://github.com/phpstats/phplyr): dplyr and tidyr as PHP
  functions and method chains.
- [phit](https://github.com/phpstats/phit): statistical models, through
  `DataFrame::toModelData()`. Its extension also reads CSV natively.
- [phiz](https://github.com/phpstats/phiz): plots of a `DataFrame`.
- [CmdStanPHP](https://github.com/phpstats/CmdStanPHP): a `DataFrame` as model
  data, and draws and summaries as tables.
